reference: Previous bundled guest atlas; preserve character design and style
template:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a transparent production animation sprite sheet for a music-player mascot, using the attached image ONLY as the exact character-design reference. Preserve its face, proportions, costume, colours and illustration style.
LAYOUT IS CRITICAL: EXACTLY TWENTY-FOUR complete figures, in FOUR COLUMNS and SIX ROWS. Portrait 1024 × 1536. Every cell 256 × 256. All cells contain the same one character at the same scale, centered at x=128 within its cell, feet near y=224. Leave generous completely transparent gutters and outer margins. No figures crossing cells, clipped hair, labels, borders, floor or shadows.
Rows 1–3 (cells 1–12) are ONE twelve-frame loop: MOVE_A.
Rows 4–6 (cells 13–24) are ONE different twelve-frame loop: MOVE_B.
Draw distinct progressive in-between poses so all TWELVE frames of each loop form a smooth, chronological motion. The start and end nearly match; do not repeat the end frame. Consistent head/body size and anatomy, no flickering accessories. Eyes stay open with a brief natural blink only where specified. Natural modest movements, no added props. Preserve a clean, genuinely transparent alpha background.
EXTRA SPACING: Draw each figure NO MORE THAN 190 pixels tall inside its 256-pixel cell. Leave at least 30 transparent pixels above and below every complete figure, INCLUDING the bottom row. Small figures with clear gutters; do not enlarge them to fill the sheet.

pairs.a: Gentle listening head bob: frames 1–3 the head lowers gradually, 4–6 returns to center, 7–9 lowers subtly to the opposite side, 10–12 returns to center. Shoulders breathe and hair settles. Both feet planted, arms resting low, eyes OPEN throughout.
pairs.b: Cute alternating two-step: 1 neutral; 2–4 take a small step to viewer-left shifting body weight; 5–6 return center; 7 neutral; 8–10 step to viewer-right; 11–12 return center. Knees flex softly and arms swing modestly opposite the legs. Eyes OPEN.

pairs.a: Slow side sway, body leans left over frames 1–4, passes center 5–7, leans right 8–10, returns center 11–12. Feet stay planted, hips shift gently, hands stay near hips, hair follows naturally. Eyes OPEN.
pairs.b: Friendly rhythmic wave with the SAME hand: 1–3 raise the hand on VIEWER-LEFT to shoulder height, 4–8 small wrist wave with elbow stable, 9–12 lower it to neutral. Other arm stays by hip throughout. Eyes OPEN except brief happy blink in frame 6. Never swap which hand waves.

pairs.a: Shoulder groove: alternating small shoulder lifts, right shoulder rises and settles frames 1–6, left rises and settles 7–12, elbows softly bent with hands near waist, feet planted. Subtle knee bends, eyes OPEN, no flailing arms.
pairs.b: Cute double-fist cheer: 1 neutral; 2–5 both small fists gradually rise from hips to beside shoulders; 6–7 a happy tiny tiptoe accent with eyes briefly closed in frame 6 ONLY; 8–12 lower fists and settle to neutral, eyes reopen. Hands never cover the face or go above the head.

pairs.a: Soft bounce: 1 upright, 2–4 soft knee bend lowers body, 5–6 recover upright, 7–8 tiny tiptoe lift, 9–12 settle to neutral. Keep head size unchanged, costume consistent, arms low follow gently, eyes OPEN. Feet do not leave the ground.
pairs.b: Graceful playful pivot-and-return: 1 front, 2–4 turn head and body together toward viewer-left about 45 degrees with a small foot pivot, 5–6 return front, 7 front, 8–10 turn toward viewer-right 45 degrees, 11–12 return front. Both arms low and slightly out; eyes OPEN, no full back view, no costume change.

interactions:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet, exactly the same character design and painted illustration style as the supplied reference. Keep face, costume, proportions, colours and accessories consistent. Create exactly 24 full-body poses, FOUR COLUMNS and SIX ROWS, portrait 1024 × 1536. One complete figure per square 256-pixel cell, centered, same scale, feet baseline y=224, generous transparent gaps and outer margins. Genuinely TRANSPARENT background, NO text, guides, shadows, floor or new props.
Each row is a small chronological animation:
Row 1 IDLE BLINK: neutral eyes open; eyelids halfway down; eyes gently closed; eyes reopening. Same relaxed pose, hands resting low.
Row 2 SLEEP: four subtle peaceful standing breathing poses, head gently bowed, eyes CLOSED in all four; arms relaxed. No sitting, no bubbles.
Row 3 HELLO: small anticipation; raise the hand on viewer-left near shoulder; friendly little wrist wave; lower it halfway toward resting position. Other arm stays low, eyes open, warm smile.
Row 4 PICKUP: body starts upright with surprised eyes; feet lift and knees relax slightly; feet dangle; relaxed hanging pose. No hands or objects lifting the character, no distorted anatomy.
Row 5 HELD: four small natural dangling poses, slight pendulum movement of feet and hair, open eyes, calm curious face. Torso upright, limbs relaxed.
Row 6 LANDING: feet come down; knees bend softly to absorb contact; knees recover; exact relaxed upright pose matching row1 frame1. Eyes briefly close ONLY at the crouch in frame2. Head size remains constant.
All motion is modest and cute. Keep every figure inside its own tile. Do not draw extra limbs. Preserve exact iconic character shape.
EXTRA SPACING: Every figure at most 190 pixels tall. Leave at least 30 transparent pixels above and below every complete figure, INCLUDING the bottom row. Small figures with clear gutters; do not enlarge them to fill the sheet.
